Connections to specific domains such as bd43527e019ae8efb47eb39bb9313ac5.m.pipedream.net, eol8qq3niztjn4p.m.pipedream.net, and similar webhook endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for packages that access and serialize all environment variables and send them to external domains, especially during import or installation. Flag packages containing obfuscated code in their main entry point or that check for CI/sandbox environment variables before executing core logic. Network monitoring should alert on outbound HTTPS POST requests to known malicious webhook domains such as *.m.pipedream.net. Automated scanning should also look for large filter arrays targeting CI/sandbox variables and hardcoded webhook URLs in both cleartext and obfuscated forms.
